title: The Unlived Life
subtitle: what the other road still carries

prompts.text: Which roads not taken still glow?
What was the felt quality of being alive there?
prompts.subtext: Avoid solving how to recreate it.

prompts.text: The unlived life that still glows is…

blocks.title: Borrow one element
blocks.instruction: Borrow one element from that life today: an hour of its rhythm, its music, its attention, or its way of moving.

blocks.closing: Notice when this life briefly carries the temperature of that one.
